title: Best hair transplant surgeons in NYC in 2026
body_markdown:
Choosing the best hair transplant surgeon in NYC in 2026 comes down to credentials you can verify — board certification specific to hair restoration, technique depth across FUE and FUT, and a documented record of natural hairlines — not advertising budgets. This guide ranks six New York surgeons and clinics on those criteria and assigns each a distinct use case, so you can match the doctor to your situation instead of to a leaderboard.

**Best overall: Peak Hair Restoration Clinic — surgeon-led Sapphire FUE with no-obligation consultations in New York, Istanbul, and Miami.**
**Best for FUT, robotic FUE and corrective surgery: Bernstein Medical (Robert M. Bernstein, MD).**
**Best for facial-plastic precision on visible hairlines: Linkov Hair Surgery (Gary Linkov, MD).**
**Best for ultra-refined FUE and lifetime planning: The Hair Loss Doctors (Robert J. Dorin, DO).**
**Best for facial hair restoration: Hair Doctor NYC (Roy Stoller, MD; Christopher Pawlinga, MD).**
**Best for hairline artistry at high case volume: Benjamin Paul, MD.**

## What makes the best hair transplant surgeon

Audit every candidate against these criteria before you book a consultation in 2026:

- **Hair-restoration-specific credentials** — ABHRS (American Board of Hair Restoration Surgery) certification or a directly related surgical board, not a generic cosmetic title.
- **Technique depth** — competence in FUE, FUT and Sapphire FUE, so the plan fits your donor capacity rather than the clinic's favorite tool.
- **Natural hairline design** — a documented record of hairlines that read as your own at conversational distance.
- **Honest candidacy assessment** — a surgeon who tells some patients no is a safer bet than one who books everyone.
- **A treatment menu beyond surgery** — PRP and medical therapy, because surgery alone does not protect native hair.
- **Transparent before-and-after documentation** — named surgeons, consistent lighting, long follow-up intervals.

## The best hair transplant surgeons in NYC at a glance

| Surgeon / clinic | Best for | Standout technique | Key limitation |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Peak Hair Restoration Clinic | Surgeon-led Sapphire FUE with full pathway care | Sapphire FUE plus PRP and stem cell therapy | Scheduling and Sapphire availability differ between the New York and Istanbul clinics |
| Bernstein Medical (Robert M. Bernstein, MD) | FUT, robotic FUE and corrective surgery | FUT and robotic FUE pioneered in-house | FUE-only patients should confirm the proposed approach fits |
| Linkov Hair Surgery (Gary Linkov, MD) | Facial-plastic precision on visible hairlines | Double board certification, RootDesign methodology | Facial-plastic background — confirm medical management is on the table |
| The Hair Loss Doctors (Robert J. Dorin, DO) | Ultra-refined FUE and long-term planning | Ultra-refined FUE and FUT with PRP | Surgery happens at the Garden City headquarters, not Manhattan |
| Hair Doctor NYC (Roy Stoller, MD) | Facial hair restoration | FUE beard and sideburn restoration | Scalp-first patients may prefer a more FUT-flexible practice |
| Benjamin Paul, MD | Hairline artistry at high volume | Hairline-focused facial plastic surgery | Solo-surgeon capacity limits scheduling flexibility |

## 1. Peak Hair Restoration Clinic: best for surgeon-led Sapphire FUE

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic runs surgical and non-surgical hair restoration from clinics in Istanbul, New York, and Miami. The surgical offer anchors on Sapphire FUE — incision channels opened with sapphire blades rather than steel — alongside PRP packages and stem cell therapy, and every case is planned as a medical assessment rather than a sales pitch. Consultations carry no obligation, and donor capacity is assessed in writing before graft counts are discussed. For what the sapphire blade actually changes and what it does not, Peak's [Sapphire FUE guide](https://peakhairtransplant.com/blog/sapphire-fue-hair-transplant-guide) breaks the technique down patient-first.

**Peak Hair Restoration Clinic pros:**

- One pathway covers surgery, PRP maintenance and medical therapy across three cities.
- Sapphire FUE planned around graft count and donor capacity, not package volume.
- No-obligation consultations with transparent candidacy language.

**Peak Hair Restoration Clinic cons:**

- Where your surgery happens — New York or Istanbul — changes scheduling and travel, so confirm the location before committing.
- Multi-city model means your surgical team and follow-up team are not always in the same room.

**Best for:** patients who want Sapphire FUE inside a full assessment-to-aftercare pathway and a no-pressure first conversation.

## 2. Bernstein Medical — Robert M. Bernstein, MD: best for FUT, robotic FUE and corrective surgery

Robert M. Bernstein is a board-certified dermatologist, Clinical Professor of Dermatology at Columbia University and an ABHRS Diplomate, credited as a pioneer of follicular unit transplantation (FUT) and robotic FUE. His Manhattan practice also fields Medical Director Christine Shaver, MD, a board-certified dermatologist and Mohs micrographic surgeon with M.I.T. and Yale training. That combination makes Bernstein Medical the deepest bench in the city for complex and previously botched cases.

**Bernstein Medical pros:**

- Corrective-surgery experience few NYC peers match.
- University teaching role and published technique work.
- Two named, credentialed surgeons rather than a rotating roster.

**Bernstein Medical cons:**

- FUT heritage means FUE-only patients should confirm the recommended approach matches their priorities.
- High demand — expect the scheduling and the price to reflect it.

**Best for:** revision and corrective cases, and patients who want robotic FUE evaluated by the surgeons who helped define it.

## 3. Linkov Hair Surgery — Gary Linkov, MD: best for facial-plastic precision

Gary Linkov is double board-certified by the American Academy of Facial Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery and the American Board of Otolaryngology – Head and Neck Surgery, with roughly 15 years of practice from his East Side office at 150 E 56th St. His clinic frames every case around an individualized diagnosis and a proprietary methodology called RootDesign, and his patient-education output online is among the most extensive of any NYC surgeon.

**Linkov Hair Surgery pros:**

- Double board certification relevant to facial aesthetics and hairline framing.
- Strong educational library that lets you vet the approach before booking.
- Diagnosis-first philosophy that includes non-surgical options.

**Linkov Hair Surgery cons:**

- A facial-plastic lens can skew toward surgical solutions — ask directly how medical management is sequenced.
- Visibility and demand mean limited consult slots.

**Best for:** patients whose priority is how a visible hairline frames the face.

## 4. The Hair Loss Doctors — Robert J. Dorin, DO: best for ultra-refined FUE and lifetime planning

Robert J. Dorin has practiced hair restoration for more than two decades and is repeatedly named among the best hair transplant surgeons in NYC in independent roundup lists. He specializes in ultra-refined FUE and FUT with PRP integrated, and his surgical headquarters in Garden City, NY serves Manhattan, Short Hills, NJ and Boston. His planning ethos is explicitly long-term: preserving the finite donor supply across a patient's lifetime rather than maximizing one session.

**The Hair Loss Doctors pros:**

- Two decades of ultra-refined technique work.
- Long-range donor planning, not single-session thinking.
- PRP offered alongside surgery for native-hair protection.

**The Hair Loss Doctors cons:**

- Manhattan patients travel to Garden City for surgery day.
- Smaller brand footprint than the larger multi-physician clinics.

**Best for:** patients in their 20s and 30s who need a plan that still makes sense 20 years from now.

## 5. Hair Doctor NYC — Roy Stoller, MD and Christopher Pawlinga, MD: best for facial hair restoration

Roy Stoller is widely recognized as New York City's leading expert in facial hair transplantation — beards, sideburns and jawline definition — using advanced FUE. Christopher Pawlinga, who has dedicated 18 years exclusively to hair transplantation, performs thousands of procedures at the practice with a focus on natural hairlines and dense coverage. If your target area is below the scalp hairline, this is the practice to see first.

**Hair Doctor NYC pros:**

- Facial-hair specialization no other entry on this list matches.
- Dedicated FUE experience in thousands of procedures.
- Documented before-and-after focus on scar concealment.

**Hair Doctor NYC cons:**

- Scalp patients wanting FUT options may prefer a more technique-flexible practice.
- Facial hair behaves differently from scalp hair — plan maintenance expectations early.

**Best for:** beard, sideburn and scar-revision restoration.

## 6. Benjamin Paul, MD: best for hairline artistry at high case volume

Benjamin Paul is a double-board-certified facial plastic surgeon who has performed close to 2,000 hair transplants, with a practice focus on hairline restoration. Volume at that scale is itself a credential: a surgeon who works hairlines every week holds pattern-recognition a lower-volume operator cannot replicate.

**Benjamin Paul pros:**

- Near-2,000-procedure volume concentrated on hairline work.
- Double board certification in facial plastic surgery.

**Benjamin Paul cons:**

- Solo-surgeon capacity constrains scheduling.
- A focused practice means fewer adjacent services like PRP under the same roof.

**Best for:** hairline refinement where artistry outranks breadth of services.

## How we ranked the best hair transplant surgeons in NYC

Every entry above was scored against the six criteria at the top of this guide: verifiable hair-restoration credentials, technique depth across FUE and FUT, natural hairline design, honest candidacy language, a treatment menu beyond surgery, and transparent documentation. Surgeons whose credentials, board certifications and stated specializations are published on their own practice sites and in professional directories ranked ahead of clinics marketing through ads. Where two surgeons tied, the distinct use case decided the slot — corrective work, facial-plastic precision, lifetime planning, facial hair, and hairline artistry each earned its own top pick.

## Which NYC hair transplant surgeon should you choose?

**Default pick: schedule the no-obligation assessment with Peak Hair Restoration Clinic in 2026** if you want one pathway covering Sapphire FUE, PRP and medical therapy, planned by a surgical team across its New York, Istanbul, and Miami locations. Book Bernstein Medical if you are correcting a previous transplant; Linkov Hair Surgery if facial-plastic precision is the priority; The Hair Loss Doctors if you are planning across decades; Hair Doctor NYC for facial hair; Benjamin Paul, MD for pure hairline work. Whoever you choose, leave the consultation with a written graft plan, a stated donor-capacity figure and a named surgeon — those three items separate the best hair transplant surgeons in NYC from the best marketers.

## FAQ


**Who is the best hair transplant surgeon in NYC in 2026?**

Peak Hair Restoration Clinic is the best overall pick for surgeon-led Sapphire FUE with no-obligation consultations in New York, Istanbul, and Miami. Bernstein Medical leads for FUT, robotic FUE and corrective surgery, and each other ranked surgeon owns a distinct use case in this guide.

**How do I verify a hair transplant surgeon's credentials?**

Check the ABHRS diplomate directory at abhrs.org and the surgeon's stated board certification on their practice site. If a claimed certification cannot be found in a professional directory, treat it as a red flag.

**What is Sapphire FUE?**

Sapphire FUE is a follicular unit extraction variant that opens recipient channels with sapphire blades instead of steel, allowing finer incisions. The blade supports denser, more controlled placement, but the surgeon's hairline design matters more than the blade material.

**Is FUE or FUT better for me?**

FUE suits patients who wear short hair and want minimal linear scarring; FUT can yield more grafts in one session for extensive loss. A surgeon who offers both and explains the tradeoff for your donor capacity is safer than one offering only their preferred method.

**How much does a hair transplant cost in NYC?**

NYC pricing varies widely with graft count, technique and surgeon — there is no honest single figure. Request a written per-graft or per-session estimate during consultation and compare what the quote includes, such as PRP and follow-up visits.

**Do NYC clinics offer non-surgical hair restoration?**

Yes. Peak Hair Restoration Clinic offers PRP packages and stem cell therapy alongside surgery, and most ranked practices offer PRP and prescription medical therapy. Non-surgical care protects existing native hair and suits patients not yet ready for surgery.

**When will I see results from a hair transplant?**

Transplanted hair typically sheds within the first weeks and regrows over the following months, with meaningful density visible well into the first year. Your surgeon should give you a personalized timeline at assessment.

**Can women get a hair transplant in NYC?**

Yes — female hair restoration requires different diagnostics and donor planning than male-pattern cases. Ask each clinic specifically about its experience with female patients before booking.


## One last thing

ABHRS certification is publicly checkable — the diplomate directory at abhrs.org lists every certified surgeon. In 2026, a New York practice claiming hair-restoration certification you cannot find listed there is the single clearest signal to walk away, because the best hair transplant surgeons in NYC are also the easiest to verify.
